notional_positions.notes: Crude oil and feedstock purchase obligation derivatives designated as fair value hedges (inventory hedging). These are long purchase commitments. Fair value hedge accounting designated.

Crude oil economic hedges (not designated). Used to manage price volatility in crude inventory and purchase/sale transactions. Direction not specified in filing; assumed net short as inventory hedging.
Refined products economic hedges (not designated). Used to manage price volatility. Direction not specified in filing; assumed net short as inventory hedging.

warnings: PBF does not disclose gross long/short positions separately. Economic hedge directions are inferred (assumed net short for inventory hedging).
